title: The slough
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The road floods at the slough south of town. A flagger turns everyone around. Wood turns around, parks, and draws the water over the road for the hour he'd have spent in class.

panels.composition: 101 at the slough, water across both lanes, a FLAGGER in orange with a sign, cars turning around. The Datsun.

image.prompt: a two-lane coastal highway flooded at a slough with a flagger in orange holding a sign and cars turning around in the rain, black and white, no words
a flagger in orange rain gear at a small car's window, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The pad: the water over the road, the road's center line going under it and coming out the other side.

image.prompt: a drawing pad showing floodwater across a highway with the center line disappearing under it and emerging beyond, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The Datsun parked on the shoulder. Wood drawing. The flagger, a hundred yards off, drawing too — no. Smoking. The strip checked.

image.prompt: a small car parked on a highway shoulder above floodwater, a young man drawing inside, a flagger far off in the rain, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'When it drops.' The hour of class spent on the water.
